evidence_classes.execution_result: post-action observation or sensor result recorded with time and episode identity
evidence_classes.graph_hypothesis: unvalidated node, edge, precondition, or recovery proposal from L1V
evidence_classes.image_fact: fact visible in the supplied observation, with view provenance
evidence_classes.oracle_reference: simulator-only truth, segregated from online method features

unknown_policy: unknown and not_observed remain distinct from false
